readme: The look pass material library for tools/arch (materials.py). One entry per glTF material (= one draw call, one lightmap). Colours are sRGB hex. 'texture' names a CC0 set in assets-src/textures/<id>/ (<id>_diff|nor_gl|arm_<res>.jpg, docs/handover/look-textures.md); without the files the material falls back to its flat 'color'. 'tile' is the real size of one texture repeat in metres (world-space box projection into UVMap = TEXCOORD_0). 'process' recolours the photo: 'tint' is the new mean colour, 'contrast' scales the luminance detail, 'saturation' keeps that much of the photo's own chroma; 'roughness' [mean, spread] remaps the ARM green channel. 'res' is the exported size per map (0 = map not used). 'grain': 'vertical' turns the texture 90 degrees on walls (slats). 'bevel' [width m, segments] is applied to the joined mesh (harden normals). 'lightmap' forces a lightmap size (else by area); 'bakeSamples' its Cycles samples (default 512; generate.py --bake-samples overrides all, for quick tests). 'bake': false = no lightmap (emissive, glass). SHARED LIBRARY (docs/handover/rollout-kit.md): 'textureSets' are processed texture sets several materials share (their GPU memory counts once); a material with 'set' (a set name, or '@<Material>' for that material's own maps) reads the set's images ('maps' limits which) and gets a constant colour factor so that its mean is 'color' (glTF baseColorFactor, <= 1: sets are processed bright). 'generate' makes a set procedurally (seeded numpy). 'roles' maps each surface of the building to its material: zones ask role -> material, never hard-code a look. Palette materials hold 'paletteSlots' swatches (the faces' 'Mat:<i>' index).

speckle.note: fine granular chips (the terrazzo photo, every joint removed, low contrast, near white): sheet vinyl floors and acoustic ceiling tiles

leather.note: wipe-clean upholstery vinyl grain (CC0 leather_white, 0.3 m)

weave.note: fine synthetic weave (CC0 terlenka, 0.266 m): cubicle curtains, bed linen, blankets

brushed.note: brushed stainless steel, generated (Poly Haven has none): streaks along U, metallic 1

SheetVinyl.note: clinical sheet vinyl (wards, ER, imaging, corridors): light grey-blue granular chips, satin; welded seams, coved skirting (kit.arch.coved_skirting)

TheatreFloor.note: anti-static (conductive) vinyl for theatres and the sterile core: a cooler, slightly deeper grey-green

SafetyVinyl.note: slip-resistant safety vinyl for wet rooms (en-suites, sluice, scrub): warm grey, finer chips, rougher

Rubber.note: rubber: castor tyres, bumpers, stair nosings, rubber floor; near-black, matt

WallTintBlue.note: calm accent wall paint (ward A, imaging waiting): the white plaster set, tinted

WallTintSage.note: calm accent wall paint (ward B, quiet rooms): the white plaster set, tinted

WallTintSand.note: calm accent wall paint (atrium, cafe, lounges): the white plaster set, tinted

WallTintLilac.note: calm accent wall paint (diagnostics): the white plaster set, tinted

CrashRail.note: wall protection: vinyl crash rails, corner guards, door protection; satin warm light grey

VinylTeal.note: wipe-clean upholstery vinyl (seats, recliners, mattresses, trolley pads)

VinylGrey.note: wipe-clean upholstery vinyl (seats, recliners, mattresses, trolley pads)

VinylSage.note: wipe-clean upholstery vinyl (seats, recliners, mattresses, trolley pads)

Curtain.note: cubicle and bay curtains, cellular blankets: pale blue-grey weave; a thin closed sheet (both faces bake)

Linen.note: bed linen, pillows, folded towels: white cotton weave

Stainless.note: brushed stainless steel (sinks, trolleys, IV poles, kick plates); generated streaks, metallic

PowderWhite.note: powder-coated white metal and white device plastic (bed frames, lift columns, pendants, carts)

KitPlastic.note: every small coloured plastic part in ONE draw call: the face's swatch picks the colour (Mat:<i>; 0 white, 1 light grey, 2 mid grey, 3 graphite, 4 black, 5 sharps yellow, 6 signal red, 7 glove blue, 8 green, 9 orange, 10 purple, 11 slate blue, 12 pale blue, 13 crash-cart red, 14 warm white, 15 clear blue)

Screen.note: a monitor's dark glass face (the runtime puts its live canvas there; kit anchors 'screen' give the rectangles)

AcousticTile.note: tegular mineral-fibre ceiling tiles (clinical areas): fine fissures/pinholes from the speckle set, near white, matt

Lawn.note: mown healthy lawn (ground.lawn): CC0 Poly Haven sparse_grass (2 m tile) recoloured to a light green with its own blade detail (process.hueRamp: the photo's luminance picks the hue between a cool and a warm green); used at 1.5 m

LawnB.note: the darker mowing stripe of the lawn (ground.lawn.alt): the same images as Lawn (counted once), a constant factor darker; alternate 1 m stripes read as a mown lawn

Foliage.note: planting (plant.foliage): tree and shrub leaves, ornamental grass blades, ground cover; one palette of 12 greens (the face's swatch 'Foliage:<i>': 0 deep ... 7 pale tip, 8-9 blue-green, 10-11 golden) so every leaf and blade has its own tone; double sided, its own 1024 lightmap
